onboarding_spec.onboarding_rule: Copy operator_profile.template.{md,json} into ./<operator_slug>/profile.{md,json}, register entry here, keep zero secrets inside .agents/.

operational_rules.on_session_boot: Load active operator profile alongside host/hardware_calibration.json and active CPI-SI profile so communication, schedule rhythm, and executive authority stay grounded.
operational_rules.adding_new_operators: Keep multi-tenant isolation strict: each new Operator gets an isolated subfolder and Track 3 vault without touching Prime Operator privacy.
operational_rules.toml_separation: Keep human personhood in JSON/Markdown here; machine-local shell/editor/git overrides belong in future Track 5/runtime user.toml configs.
